symptom: A message definition member over a one-to-one association (`type Reference owner Both`) fails `mx check` with CE6524 "The occurrence of 'Shop.CustomerProfile_Customer' has changed" — on CREATE, on CREATE OR MODIFY of unchanged describe output, and on ALTER … ADD MEMBER; `exec` and `describe` look clean
cause: `resolveAssociationCardinality` returned MaxOccurs -1 for every REVERSE traversal (holder is the TO end). Owner Both on a Reference makes it one-to-one, so the reverse is a single object (1) too
insight: The cardinality table had two axes measured (direction, Reference vs ReferenceSet) and a third that the corpus never exercised: OWNER. When a rule's measurement corpus has no example of a property (no ReferenceSet then, no Owner Both now), the rule is unmeasured on that property, not exceptionless. CE6524 is a reliable oracle for the occurrence — mxbuild recomputes it from the domain model — so the fix is settled by mx check, no Studio Pro reference needed: base build 2x CE6524, fixed 0, with the forward definition in the same script as the control (clean on both). Owner is read from the association already in hand; ReferenceSet Owner Both stays -1 both ways. Tests `TestOneToOneAssociationIsSingleInBothDirections`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1386-message-definition-one-to-one-occurrence.mdl`
